comment: Dutch strings of the shared listicle card design, used by scripts/listicle.py build-lang for every page and site. ui: template strings (keys of UI_EN in listicle.py); js: strings of the shared JS (keys of JS_UI_EN), written into the page as <script type="application/json" id="listicle-ui">; text: phrases many cards repeat (English fragment -> Dutch). A page's own file (data/listicles/i18n/<slug>/nl.json) overrides any of them.
